identity.name: Tulasi
identity.botanical_name: Ocimum tenuiflorum L. (syn. Ocimum sanctum L.)

identification.description: Aromatic erect subshrub with quadrangular stems, opposite aromatic leaves and terminal racemes of small flowers.

shlokas:
तुलसी सुरसा ग्राम्या सुलभा बहुमञ्जरी ।
अपेतराक्षसी गौरी भूतघ्नी देवदुन्दुभिः ॥५०॥
तुलसी कटुका तिक्ता हृद्योष्णा दाहपित्तकृत् ।
दीपनी कुष्ठकृच्छ्रास्रपार्श्वरुक्कफवातजित् ।
शुक्ला कृष्णा च तुलसी गुणैस्तुल्या प्रकीर्तिता ॥५१॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 50–51 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 62–63 numbering and wording were corrected

identification.description: Medium to large evergreen tree with pinnate leaves, serrated leaflets, small white flowers and ovoid drupes.

shlokas:
निम्बः स्यात्पिचुमर्दश्च पिचुमन्दश्च तिक्तकः ।
अरिष्टः पारिभद्रश्च हिङ्गुनिर्यास इत्यपि ॥९३॥
निम्बः शीतो लघुर्ग्राही कटुपाकोऽग्निवातनुत् ।
अहृद्यः श्रमतृट्कासज्वरारुचिकृमिप्रणुत् ।
व्रणपित्तकफच्छर्दिकुष्ठहृल्लासमेहनुत् ॥९४॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 93–94 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 83–85 citation and wording were corrected

identity.name: Kutaja
identity.botanical_name: Holarrhena pubescens Wall. ex G.Don (syn. Holarrhena antidysenterica Wall. ex A.DC.)

identification.description: Small tree with pale bark, opposite elliptic leaves, white fragrant flowers and paired long follicles containing comose seeds.

shlokas:
कुटजः कूटजः कीटो वत्सको गिरिमल्लिका ।
कालिङ्गः शक्रशाखी च मल्लिकापुष्प इत्यपि ।
इन्द्रो यवफलः प्रोक्तो वृक्षकः पाण्डुरद्रुमः ॥१०१॥
कुटजः कटुको रूक्षो दीपनस्तुवरो हिमः ।
अर्शोऽतिसारपित्तास्रकफतृष्णामकुष्ठनुत् ॥१०२॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 101–102 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 116–117 citation and wording were corrected

identity.name: Vasa
identity.botanical_name: Justicia adhatoda L. (syn. Adhatoda vasica Nees)

identification.description: Evergreen shrub with opposite lanceolate leaves and dense spikes bearing white flowers marked with purple or red veins.

shlokas:
वासको वासिका वासा भिषङ्माता च सिंहिका ।
सिंहास्यो वाजिदन्ता स्यादाटरूषोऽटरूषकः ॥८८॥
अटरूषो वृषस्ताम्रः सिंहपर्णश्च स स्मृतः ।
वासको वातकृत्स्वर्यः कफपित्तास्रनाशनः ॥८९॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 88–89 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 88–89 citation was correct but supplied verse wording was corrected

identity.name: Arjuna
identity.botanical_name: Terminalia arjuna (Roxb. ex DC.) Wight & Arn.

identification.description: Large tree with smooth grey to grey-white bark, oblong leaves and characteristic five-winged woody fruits.

shlokas:
ककुभोऽर्जुननामाख्यो नदीसर्जश्च कीर्तितः ।
इन्द्रद्रुर्वीरवृक्षश्च वीरश्च धवलः स्मृतः ॥२३॥
ककुभः शीतलो हृद्यः क्षतक्षयविषास्रजित् ।
मेदोमेहव्रणान् हन्ति तुवरः कफपित्तहृत् ॥२४॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Vatadi Varga, verses 23–24 in the searchable recension; numbering varies by edition.
classical_reference.shloka_reference_status: verified text; supplied 26–27 citation and wording were corrected
